description: Global 30m Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "hydrology", published or maintained by The Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF). Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) is a terrain model that normalizes topography to the relative heights along the drainage network and is used to describe the relative soil gravitational potentials or the local drainage potentials. Each pixel value represents the vertical distance to the nearest drainage. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag hydrology and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: None, except HAND may be updated if the. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
